page.title: What happens after Enter?
page.description: Follow a web request from a name in the address bar to pixels on your screen. Change the DNS cache and spot what changes — and what doesn't.

props.label: Check yourself: does cached DNS mean no server request?
props.text: No. A DNS cache stores the address for a name, not the web page. In this model, a fresh DNS answer avoids asking the resolver again, but the browser still opens a connection and requests the page. A page cache or an existing connection could avoid other work; those are separate mechanisms.

reply: A ready-made explainer, not a live trace. Select the DNS step, switch between an empty and fresh cache, then follow the request to the server. No network calls or model connection are needed to explore it.
